---
title: R Training Timetable
format: 
  pdf:
    tbl-colwidths: [7,7,86]
---

- R Best Practices: August 3-12 (plus one office hour on August 18)
- Making Better Graphics: August 17-26 (plus office hour on September 2)
- Functions & Debugging: August 31-September 9 (plus office hour on September 16)
- Introduction to Quarto: Sept 14-23 (plus office hour on Sept 30)
- targets & geotargets: Sept 28 - October 21 (final office hour on October 21)

## Week 1 — Aug 3

| Day | Time | Sessions |
|-----|------|----------|
| Mon | 10-11 | 📘 **R Best Practices**: Project Organisation - common patterns, pitfalls, file paths, RStudio/Positron setup |
| Mon | 11-12 | 📘 **R Best Practices**: Code Style and Readability — consistent names, spaces, indentation, {air} formatter, linters |
| Tue | 10-11 | 📘 **R Best Practices**: Writing Readable Code — good vs bad variable names, de-chunking code, code review |
| Wed | 10-11 | 💬 **R Best Practices**: Office hour 1 |

## Week 2 — Aug 10

| Day | Time | Sessions |
|-----|------|----------|
| Mon | 10-11 | 📘 **R Best Practices**: Writing Functions — anatomy of a function, good design, {fnmate}, using a debugger |
| Mon | 11-12 | 📘 **R Best Practices**: Writing a Reprex / Getting Unstuck — {reprex}, sharing problems, practical debugging tips |
| Tue | 10-11 | 📘 **R Best Practices**: Putting It All Together — code review on existing project, apply linting, styling, functions |
| Wed | 10-11 | 💬 **R Best Practices**: Office hour 2 |

## Week 3 — Aug 17

| Day | Time | Sessions |
|-----|------|----------|
| Mon | 10-11 | 📘 **Better Graphics**: Introduction & Scatterplots — ggplot2 philosophy, anatomy, aesthetics (x, y, colour, shape, size) |
| Mon | 11-12 | 📘 **Better Graphics**: Bar Plots & Histograms — geom_bar vs geom_col, fct_infreq, fill vs colour, position, binwidths |
| Tue | 10-11 | 📘 **Better Graphics**: Faceting & Small Multiples — facet_wrap, facet_grid, proximity principle, ordering |
| Wed | 10-11 | 💬 **R Best Practices**: Office Hour 3|
| Wed | 11-12 | 💬 **Better Graphics**: Office Hour 1 |

## Week 4 — Aug 24

| Day | Time | Sessions |
|-----|------|----------|
| Mon | 10-11 | 📘 **Better Graphics**: Tidy Data & Line Graphs — why tidy data matters, pivot_longer/wider, geom_line, group |
| Mon | 11-12 | 📘 **Better Graphics**: Polishing and Extensions — labs, colourblind palettes, themes, legends, patchwork, marquee, saving |
| Tue | 10-11 | 📘 **Better Graphics**: Advanced Topics & Practice — overplotting, gghighlight, ggrepel, boxplots, gganimate, ggiraph, naniar |
| Wed | 10-11 | 💬 **Better Graphics**: Office hour 2 |

## Week 5 — Aug 31

| Day | Time | Sessions |
|-----|------|----------|
| Mon | 10-11 | 📘 **Functions & Debugging**: Why Functions Matter — managing complexity, expressing ideas, beyond DRY, DRRY |
| Mon | 11-12 | 📘 **Functions & Debugging**: Function Fundamentals & Design — anatomy, signatures, outside-in vs inside-out, naming |
| Tue | 10-11 | 📘 **Functions & Debugging**: Writing Functions in Practice — imagining ideal interfaces, extracting from code, ladder of abstraction |
| Wed | 10-11 | 💬 **Functions & Debugging**: Office hour 1|
| Wed | 11-12 | 💬 **Better Graphics**: Office hour 3 |

## Week 6 — Sep 7

| Day | Time | Sessions |
|-----|------|----------|
| Mon | 10-11 | 📘 **Functions & Debugging**: Debugging Basics & Tools — reading errors, browser(), debug(), debugonce(), RStudio debugging |
| Mon | 11-12 | 📘 **Functions & Debugging**: Cleaning Up a Data Analysis — script to functions, chunking code, practical debugging with browser() |
| Tue | 10-11 | 📘 **Functions & Debugging**: Measuring, and improving function speed |
| Tue | 11-12 | 📘 **Functions & Debugging**: Practice & Integration — work on your own code, apply approaches, code as writing |
| Wed | 10-11 | 💬 **Functions & Debugging**: Office hour 2|

## Week 7 — Sep 14

| Day | Time | Sessions |
|-----|------|----------|
| Mon | 10-11 | 📘 **Quarto**: Introduction & Basic Documents — why Quarto, installation, first .qmd, YAML, rendering workflow |
| Mon | 11-12 | 📘 **Quarto**: Multiple Output Formats — HTML/PDF/Word, format-specific YAML, keyboard shortcuts |
| Tue | 10-11 | 📘 **Quarto**: Figures & Tables — fig-cap, fig-width/height, cross-referencing, kable, gt, flextable |
| Wed | 10-11 | 💬 **Quarto**: Office hour 1|
| Wed | 11-12 | 💬 **Functions & Debugging**: Office hour 3|

## Week 8 — Sep 21

| Day | Time | Sessions |
|-----|------|----------|
| Mon | 10-11 | 📘 **Quarto**: Mathematics & Cross-References — inline/display math, LaTeX, equation labels, full cross-ref system |
| Mon | 11-12 | 📘 **Quarto**: Citations & Bibliographies — .bib files, citation syntax, CSL styles, Zotero, debugging |
| Tue | 10-11 | 📘 **Quarto**: Advanced Topics & Personal Projects — revealjs, websites, books, journal templates, convert your docs |
| Wed | 10-11 | 💬 **Quarto**: Office hour 2|

\newpage

## Week 9 — Sep 28

| Day | Time | Sessions |
|-----|------|----------|
| Mon | 10-11 | 📘 **targets**: Why Pipelines? — where do I start, common problems, intro to {targets}, concepts |
| Mon | 11-12 | 📘 **targets**: Starting with Functions — functions as unit of understanding, ideal properties, {fnmate} |
| Tue | 10-11 | 📘 **targets**: Debugging Functions — browser(), debug(), debugonce(), options(recover) |
| Wed | 10-11 | 💬 **targets**: Office hour 1|
| Wed | 11-12 | 💬 **Quarto**: Office hour 3|

## Week 10 — Oct 6 (labour day is Oct 5)

| Day | Time | Sessions |
|-----|------|----------|
| Tue | 10-11 | 📘 **targets**: Getting Started with {targets} (Part 1) — {tflow} setup, _targets.R, folder structure, tar_assign() |
| Tue | 11-12 | 📘 **targets**: Getting Started with {targets} (Part 2) — your first pipeline, modifying and rebuilding |
| Wed | 10-11 | 💬 **targets**: Office hour 2|
| Wed | 11-12 | 💬 **targets**: Office hour 3|

## Week 11 — Oct 12

| Day | Time | Sessions |
|-----|------|----------|
| Mon | 10-11 | 📘 **targets**: Deeper Workflow (Part 1) — tar_read(), tar_quarto(), keyboard shortcuts |
| Mon | 11-12 | 📘 **targets**: Deeper Workflow (Part 2) — tar_workspaces() to debug issues, common pipeline problems |
| Tue | 11-12 | 📘 **targets**: Advanced Targets — {crew} parallelisation, branching, HPC |
| Tue | 10-11 | 📘 **targets**: Production Workflows — organising large projects, convert your own work into a pipeline |
| Wed | 10-11 | 💬 **targets**: Office hour 4|
| Wed | 11-12 | 💬 **targets**: Office hour 5|

## Week 12 — Oct 19

| Day | Time | Sessions |
|-----|------|----------|
| Mon | 10-11 | 📘 **targets**: Pipeline Review & Next Steps — feedback on your pipeline, resources, open Q&A |
| Mon | 11-12 | 📘 **geotargets**: Introduction to Geospatial Data — spatial data challenges, {terra} and {sf} |
| Tue | 10-11 | 📘 **geotargets**: Geospatial Pipelines with {geotargets} — tar_terra_rast(), tar_terra_vect(), building a pipeline |
| Tue | 11-12 | 📘 **targets/geotargets**: general discussion and feedback |
| Wed | 10-11 | 💬 **targets/geotargets**: Office hour 6 |
| Wed | 11-12 | 💬 **targets/geotargets**: Office hour / feedback |
